form.label: CoolaShaker - Manufacturing Operations
form.description: Real-time production monitoring across all manufacturing lines

search.query: index=demo_mes location=$location_token$ production_rate_per_hour=* | fields _time location line_id production_rate_per_hour oee_pct availability_pct performance_pct quality_pct defect_rate_pct machine_status operator shift status
index=demo_mes location=$location_token$ event_type=quality_check | fields _time location line_id sample_id passed failed defect_types.*
index=demo_mes location=$location_token$ event_type=alarm | fields _time location line_id alarm_code alarm_description severity acknowledged

single.description: OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) = availability × performance × quality: how much of the planned production time turns into good units at target speed. Green from 85 %, red below 70 %.

search.query: | stats avg(oee_pct) as avg_oee | eval avg_oee=round(avg_oee, 1) | eval range=case( avg_oee >= 85, "low", avg_oee >= 70, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_oee low=85-100 elevated=70-85 severe=0-70
| stats avg(production_rate_per_hour) as avg_rate | eval avg_rate=round(avg_rate, 0)

| stats avg(defect_rate_pct) as avg_defect | eval avg_defect=round(avg_defect, 2) | eval range=case( avg_defect <= 2, "low", avg_defect <= 5, "guarded", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_defect low=0-2 guarded=2-5 severe=5-100
| stats dc(alarm_code) as alarm_count | eval range=case( alarm_count = 0, "low", alarm_count < 3, "guarded", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=alarm_count low=0-0 guarded=1-3 severe=4-999

chart.description: Availability = share of planned time the line runs. Performance = actual speed vs. target speed. Quality = share of good units. Multiplied together they give the OEE.

search.query: | stats avg(availability_pct) as Availability, avg(performance_pct) as Performance, avg(quality_pct) as Quality by line_id | foreach Availability Performance Quality [eval <<FIELD>>=round('<<FIELD>>', 1)]
| stats sum(defect_types.cracks) as Cracks, sum(defect_types.color_mismatch) as "Color Mismatch", sum(defect_types.dimension_out_of_spec) as "Out of Spec"

| stats latest(production_rate_per_hour) as "Current Rate", avg(production_rate_per_hour) as "Avg Rate", latest(oee_pct) as "OEE %", latest(defect_rate_pct) as "Defect %", latest(machine_status) as "Status", latest(operator) as "Operator", latest(shift) as "Shift" by location line_id | eval "Current Rate"=round('Current Rate', 0), "Avg Rate"=round('Avg Rate', 0), "OEE %"=round('OEE %', 1), "Defect %"=round('Defect %', 2) | sort location line_id | rename location as Location, line_id as "Line ID"

| eval alarm_time=strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S") | sort -_time | head 20 | stats values(*) as * by location,line_id,alarm_code | rename alarm_time as "Time", location as "Location", line_id as "Line ID", alarm_code as "Code", alarm_description as "Description", severity as "Severity", acknowledged as "Ack"

index=demo_mes location=$location_token$ event_type=material_consumption | stats sum(consumed_kg) as "Total Consumed (kg)", latest(remaining_kg) as "Remaining (kg)" by location material_type | eval "Total Consumed (kg)"=round('Total Consumed (kg)', 1), "Remaining (kg)"=round('Remaining (kg)', 0) | rename location as Location, material_type as "Material Type" | sort Location "Material Type"

index=demo_mes location=$location_token$ event_type=inventory | stats latest(finished_goods) as "Finished Goods", latest(warehouse_capacity_pct) as "Capacity %" by location | eval "Finished Goods"=tostring('Finished Goods', "commas"), "Capacity %"=round('Capacity %', 1) | rename location as Location | sort Location

index=demo_mes location=$location_token$ production_rate_per_hour=* ai_inspection_mode=* | stats count(eval(ai_inspection_mode="inline")) as inline count as total | eval inline_pct=round(inline / total * 100, 1) | fields inline_pct
index=demo_mes location=$location_token$ production_rate_per_hour=* ai_inspection_latency_ms=* | stats avg(ai_inspection_latency_ms) as latency | eval latency=round(latency, 0)
index=demo_mes location=$location_token$ production_rate_per_hour=* ai_inspection_mode=fallback_manual | stats dc(eval(mvindex(location, 0) . ":" . line_id)) as lines
index=demo_mes location=$location_token$ production_rate_per_hour=* ai_inspection_latency_ms=* | timechart span=1m avg(ai_inspection_latency_ms) by location

index=demo_mes location=$location_token$ production_rate_per_hour=* ai_inspection_mode=* | stats latest(ai_inspection_mode) as "Inspection" latest(ai_inspection_latency_ms) as "AI Latency ms" avg(production_rate_per_hour) as "Units/h" avg(defect_rate_pct) as "Defect %" by location line_id | eval "Units/h"=round('Units/h', 0), "Defect %"=round('Defect %', 2) | rename location as Site line_id as Line
